title: Official Statistical Data Sources — National Statistical System of India
ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)

data_sources.name: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)
data_sources.division: National Sample Survey Office (NSSO), Survey Design and Research Division (SDRD)
data_sources.description: Primary national source estimating key employment and unemployment indicators (Labour Force Participation Rate LFPR, Worker Population Ratio WPR, Unemployment Rate UR) using a rotational sampling scheme.
data_sources.learning_use_case: Design of rotating panel surveys, standard error estimation with jackknife/bootstrap, complex sampling multipliers.

data_sources.name: Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (HCES)
data_sources.division: NSSO, Field Operations Division (FOD) & Data Quality Assurance Division (DQAD)
data_sources.description: Collects detailed consumption expenditure data across rural and urban households to derive poverty estimates and construct weighting diagrams for Consumer Price Indices (CPI).
data_sources.format: Raw Microdata, Summary Indicators, Itemized Basket CSV
data_sources.learning_use_case: Constructing Laspeyres item weights, Engel curve estimation, outlier cleaning and imputation.

data_sources.name: National Accounts Statistics (NAS) & GDP Compilation
data_sources.division: Central Statistics Office (CSO), National Accounts Division (NAD)
data_sources.description: Official macroeconomic accounts compiled according to the UN System of National Accounts (SNA 2008), measuring Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Gross Value Added (GVA), and Sectoral Balance.
data_sources.format: National Accounts Tables (.xlsx), Quarterly Press Releases (.pdf)
data_sources.learning_use_case: Balancing Supply and Use Tables, calculating deflators, adjusting for FISIM and trade/transport margins.

data_sources.name: Annual Survey of Industries (ASI)
data_sources.description: Comprehensive statistical survey of registered manufacturing factories in India under the Factories Act, 1948, tracking capital, output, employment, and value added.
data_sources.format: Unit-level Factory Records, Block-level Data, Summary Volumes
data_sources.learning_use_case: Enterprise data validation, non-response adjustments, census vs. sample sector balancing.

data_sources.name: Consumer Price Index (CPI Rural, Urban & Combined)
data_sources.description: Measures changes over time in the general level of prices of goods and services that a reference population acquires, uses or pays for consumption with Base Year 2012=100.
data_sources.learning_use_case: Modified Laspeyres index formula, substitution bias correction, seasonal adjustments in vegetable and fruit sub-indices.

data_sources.name: Index of Industrial Production (IIP)
data_sources.description: Composite indicator measuring short-term changes in the volume of production of a basket of industrial products across Mining, Manufacturing, and Electricity.
data_sources.format: Item-wise Monthly Production Indices, Growth Rates CSV
data_sources.learning_use_case: Weight reallocation, non-response imputation for large units, nowcasting GDP manufacturing components.

data_sources.name: Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (ASUSE)
data_sources.description: Dedicated nationwide survey covering unincorporated non-agricultural enterprises in manufacturing, trade, and services sectors (excluding construction).
data_sources.learning_use_case: Multi-stage stratified sampling of informal clusters, duality in enterprise sampling.

data_sources.name: MoSPI Georeferenced Survey Mapping & Spatial Data
data_sources.description: Integration of primary sampling units (FSU/SSU) with Census Enumeration Blocks, Bhuvan ISRO satellite imagery, and administrative boundary shapefiles.
data_sources.format: GeoJSON, ESRI Shapefiles (.shp), Spatial Point Layers
data_sources.learning_use_case: Spatial autocorrelation, hot-spot analysis of poverty and malnutrition, boundary harmonization across NSS rounds.

data_sources.name: Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India (data.gov.in)
data_sources.division: National Informatics Centre (NIC) & MeitY in partnership with MoSPI
data_sources.description: Central repository for published government datasets conforming to National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP), providing open APIs for data science.
data_sources.learning_use_case: Automating survey ingestion pipelines with Python Requests/Pandas, open data visualization, anomaly auditing.

data_sources.name: iGOT Karmayogi National Capacity Building Repository
data_sources.division: DoPT / Karmayogi Bharat in coordination with NSSTA
data_sources.description: Digital learning infrastructure under Mission Karmayogi hosting accredited capacity building programs for Indian civil services and official statistical cadres.
data_sources.format: SCORM Modules, Video Lessons, Interactive Assessments, Competency Credentials
data_sources.learning_use_case: Targeting diagnosed skill gaps with accredited MoSPI/NSSTA modules, tracking credit hours and certifications.
